title: Accelerated Dataflow: scaling inference in streaming data analytics with efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2610.22731v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Streaming data analytics helps businesses identify opportunities and spot risks in a timely fashion. As large language model (LLM) usage grows, people are exploring incorporating agents or LLMs in streaming data pipelines to help find patterns in datasets without supervision or interpret natural languages for content moderation. However, most streaming systems are currently optimized for data movement and perform poorly on GPU intensive workloads such as performing inference with LLMs. We introduce a system on Google Cloud Dataflow designed to tackle hybrid streaming machine learning workloads with co-designed autoscaling on heterogeneous worker pools and prefix-aware batching. This increases throughput 1.5x to 2x for streaming pipelines using LLMs while maintaining similar latency with up to 75% peak resource savings and 84% lower peak tail latency compared with existing streaming data processing systems.

translated_title: 加速数据流：在流数据分析中高效扩展推理
translated_abstract: 流数据分析帮助企业及时识别机会和发现风险。随着大语言模型使用量的增长，人们正在探索在流数据管道中集成智能体或大语言模型，以帮助在无监督情况下发现数据集中的模式，或解释自然语言用于内容审核。然而，目前大多数流式系统主要针对数据传输进行优化，在GPU密集型工作负载（如使用大语言模型进行推理）上表现不佳。我们介绍了一个基于Google Cloud Dataflow构建的系统，该系统专为处理混合流式机器学习工作负载而设计，采用在异构工作节点池上协同设计的自动扩缩容机制和前缀感知批处理技术。与现有流数据处理系统相比，该系统将使用大语言模型的流式管道吞吐量提高了1.5倍至2倍，同时保持相近的延迟，峰值资源节省高达75%，峰值尾延迟降低84%。
tldr: 该论文提出基于Google Cloud Dataflow的系统，通过异构工作节点池上的协同设计自动扩缩容和前缀感知批处理，高效扩展流式管道中的大语言模型推理，实现1.5至2倍吞吐量提升、最高75%的峰值资源节省以及84%的峰值尾延迟降低。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a system on Google Cloud Dataflow featuring co-designed autoscaling on heterogeneous worker pools and prefix-aware batching, efficiently scaling LLM inference in streaming pipelines with 1.5x-2x throughput gains, up to 75% peak resource savings, and 84% lower peak tail latency.
